senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. קוּם) existence, substance, being.
units: Koh. R. to VI, 3 מהו הי׳ קיומא what is hayy’kum (Gen. VII, 23)? Existence; R. B. says: the inhabited world (v. אִיקוּמֵינֵי); R. El. says, י׳ זה הממון וכ׳ y’kum means property (substance) which makes firm &c.; Gen. R. s. 32.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:13">Num. R. s. 18</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 119a">Pes. 119ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 11:6">Deut. XI, 6</cite>).—Pl. <he>יְקוּמִים</he>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 56:6">Yalk. Gen. 56</cite> <he>נמחו כל הי׳</he> (<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 23:8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXIII</cite> <he>היקום</he> collective noun) all beings were swept away.
